title: LTX latent preview flashes junk frames on the audio-carrying flows (foley, extend)
description:
CORRECTED 2026-08-29: the ROOT-CAUSE READ below is WRONG and both of its candidates are disproven - read plan.md instead. The real defect is that KJNodes announces VHS_latentpreview `length` in LATENT frames while streaming TAEHV-decoded PIXEL frames (8x more), so the app's ring holds only the tail of each burst. Settled from source arithmetic; the GPU run this card asked for was not needed.

Fabio, 2026-08-17: an LTX foley run's live preview 'keeps snapping to the first frame... keeps flashing something that shouldn't be there. It's not a continuous run.' Same on extend. NOT on MiniMax H3. It flashes identically in the Gallery card, the Flow result pane AND the History viewer, which places it UPSTREAM of MPI-571 - all three now share one consumer (previewClipPlayer) and simply paint what the bus delivers, so a defect common to all three is in the FRAMES, not the ring.

ROOT-CAUSE READ (source, not yet measured on a live run). Preview comes from KJNodes LTX2SamplingPreviewOverride (node 49 in flow_ltx_foley.json, preview_rate 16, taeltx2_3 VAE). Its prepare_callback (comfyui-kjnodes/nodes/ltxv_nodes.py:861-889) slices the latent before decoding:
  if x0 is not None and shape is not None:  cut = prod(shape[1:]); x0 = x0[:,:,:cut].reshape(...)
  if num_keyframes > 0:                     x0 = x0[:,:,:-num_keyframes]
and `shape` is set ONLY when `len(latent_shapes) > 1` (ltxv_nodes.py:916). The foley/extend graphs sample a CONCATENATED AV latent (LTXVConcatAVLatent, node 34) with separate GuiderParameters passes for modality AUDIO (116) and VIDEO (117). On a single-modality segment `shape` is None, so no video slice is taken and packed AUDIO tokens are decoded by the video previewer - a uniform olive field, which is exactly what Fabio's 0%-progress screenshot shows. Those junk frames enter the same PREVIEW_IMAGE stream as the real video frames, so every surface loops both. H3 has no audio latent and no keyframes, hence clean.

SECOND CANDIDATE, same code: num_keyframes comes from the positive cond's keyframe_idxs (ltxv_nodes.py:910-914), which only exist when the run is conditioned on an input video - true for extend and foley, false for H3. If that count is wrong for our graphs the slice drops the wrong tail and leaks conditioning frames into the preview.

THE MEASUREMENT THAT SETTLES IT (one LTX foley/extend run, GPU): capture the raw PREVIEW_IMAGE frames of one sampler pass and look at them in order. Junk frames interleaved 1:1 with good ones by modality pass = candidate 1. A run of sharp frames from the SOURCE video at one end of each burst = candidate 2. Log the frame count per burst and the VHS_latentpreview {length, rate} alongside - a burst shorter than the announced length also concatenates refinement generations in the ring, which looks similar.

FIX SHAPE (once measured): this is OUR graph and a KJNodes node, so prefer fixing at the source - preview only the VIDEO latent. Do NOT filter junk frames app-side by size or aspect; that is a symptom patch at the decoder boundary and it would guess.

Fabio's call: not a blocker, he can live with it. MPI-571 closed without it.
